description: Ministry of Finance Economic, Stabilization and National Policies - Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance (Chapter 420)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, specifically authorizing the conversion/exchange of domestic public debt securities into Treasury Bonds. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework for debt optimization, including the creation of new bonds, specification of interest payment methods, and transfer of privileges from old to new securities. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures under existing legislation.
